messages:
kevin: Quick spike idea — tiny route metrics card for Console that sits on route list. shows: p50/p95/p99 token-latency (token-level waterfall), throughput (req/s), and error rate; compact layout, click to expand for KV/kernel attribution.
anya: Love it. Two important infra pieces: kernel selection attribution (which kernel served tokens) and batching heuristic visibility (batch sizes distribution). We should expose a 'kernel breakdown' toggle in the expanded view. :eyes:
marta: From profiling yesterday the p99 is dominated by KV cache misses for long-context routes. Snapshot:
```
profile: route=chat-long
median_token_ms=3.1
p99_token_ms=78.4
kv_miss_tail_contrib=62%
kernel_swap_ms=8.9
```
sam: For UX, think of a mini card: left column sparkline for p95, middle compact numbers p50/p95/p99, right small micro-bars for throughput & error. Expand reveals token waterfall and a small table for kernel/batch/KV %.
kevin: Sampling question — do we send token-level breakdowns for every request? That will blow ingestion.
anya: No. We should sample tokens deterministically: e.g. 10% of requests per route using stable hashing of request_id % 10. Also aggregate into buckets for token-latency: [0-1ms,1-4ms,4-16ms,16-64ms,64+ms]. Store kernel tag and kv_hit boolean as dimensions.
marta: Agreed. Also add a short on-host profiler toggle for canaries to collect full token traces (costly but useful for regressions).
kevin: Proposal: ingest path: telemetry -> route_metrics_table (route, ts_day, bucket, kernel, kv_hit, count, tokens, errors). Then compute p50/p95/p99 via approximate histograms in query layer.
anya: That works. We have existing histogram rollups in telemetry; reuse that store but add kernel and kv_hit dims. Need a retention plan — maybe keep per-route histograms 90d, rollup to weekly after 30d.
sam: One UX ask — when p99 spikes, show top contributing dimension (kernel or kv_miss) on hover and offer 'open profiling trace' CTA.
kevin: Logged infra task and design task. Who can prototype the backend histogram schema? @anya?
anya: I'll take the backend prototype, will put a PR with schema & ingest patch by EOD Friday. :+1:
marta: I'll prepare a tiny perf harness to reproduce the KV miss tail and a sample trace to attach to the thread.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy/route-metrics-proto succeeded in staging at 1965432250 :white_check_mark:
kevin: Nice. Next: show prototype in Demo Friday 10am. If backend looks ok, we'll ship card to alpha in 2 sprints.
sam: I'll mock the compact UI now and post screenshots in #design later.
kevin: Great, thanks everyone. Closing thread for now — will reopen with PR link.
